product.description: Pure Outdoor™ by Monoprice™Weatherproof Hard Case with Customizable Foam26" x 20" x 14" multipurpose customizable IP67 weatherproof hard caseThe Pure Outdoor™ Weatherproof Hard Case is perfect for protecting your gear, whatever outdoor activities you choose. The heavy‑duty case material is both UV‑resistant and shockproof, ensuring that the case can take a beating and continue to provide full protection for your valuable equipment.22.9" x 17.3" x 13.0" internal dimensions and 5132 cu in internal volumeIP67 rating means it is 100% dust‑tight and waterproof when submerged to 1 meterUV‑resistant and shockproof polypropylene construction3" wheels and telescoping handle for easy portabilityFully customizable foam interior insertsImpact‑resistant latches and pressure‑release valveErgonomic, rubber covered handleEight 7mm padlock holes for theft protection HEAVY‑DUTY, IP67‑RATED CONSTRUCTIONEngineered for serious protection from the elements, Pure Outdoor™ weatherproof cases are made of heavy‑duty, UV‑resistant, shockproof polypropylene construction.
